transcript.content: Hello, welcome in. What brings you to see me today?
I keep snapping at people. At that safety meeting, I started yelling before I could stop myself. Now the younger inspectors seem scared to ask me anything.
Outside of those moments when you lose your temper, how has your mood been overall?

Overall… I don’t feel very good about things. I don’t trust that plant or the people running it anymore. And some days I just feel like I’m damaged goods, like I can’t even do the job I spent my whole life getting good at.
Did something happen at the plant that triggered these feelings?

Yeah. I keep going over it, thinking if I’d pushed harder about the safety checks, or stopped that run when it didn’t feel right... maybe he wouldn’t have gotten hurt so badly. I feel like I should’ve done more.
Do unwanted memories or images of the accident keep popping into your mind when you don't want them to?
Yes. A clank from a cart, or even the smell of hot oil, can put me right back in that bay. I see my coworker by the machine like it’s happening right in front of me again.
How long ago did the accident at the plant take place?
It was about two years and four months ago, after they changed us over to the overnight schedule.

final_diagnosis.reason: The patient presents with symptoms fulfilling criteria for Post-traumatic stress disorder (PTSD) following a severe workplace accident involving a coworker over two years ago. Core features include intrusive re-experiencing/flashbacks triggered by auditory and olfactory cues, persistent negative cognitions and distorted blame, and marked alterations in arousal and reactivity (irritability and verbal outbursts) causing occupational interpersonal difficulties.

confirmed_symptoms: Flashbacks and intrusive recollections of coworker's accident triggered by sensory cues (clank of a cart, smell of hot oil)
Persistent distorted blame of self for coworker's accident
Persistent negative emotional state and feelings of being 'damaged goods'
Pervasive mistrust of workplace leadership and environment
Irritability and sudden anger outbursts (yelling at colleagues during safety meeting)
